title: Perfect privacy for vector secrets
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\iota$ be any type. For every finite set $B$ of nonzero field elements with fewer than $k$ members and every pair of secrets $v,v':\iota\to F$, there is a bijection from the randomness space to itself such that, for every randomness choice and every party in $B$, the share of $v'$ under the transformed randomness equals the share of $v$ under the original randomness.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a finite set of nonzero field elements
